title: Official External Acquisition Transmission Adapter
problem: The official external acquisition runner has a safe host materialization boundary but still lacks a production Transmission adapter.
evidence: OETA-010 opened the lane from OEAM closeout and froze Transmission as the first production adapter without reopening raw action input.
OETA-020 added opt-in Transmission profile configuration, secret-reference manifest schema, official catalog schema, redaction-safe diagnostics, and config/manifest tests.
OETA-030 added a typed Transmission RPC client boundary with fake transport coverage for session-id retry, add/duplicate, get, start, stop, and redacted errors.
OETA-040 routed Transmission enqueue through host materialization and Transmission add, rejected unsupported material safely, and returned only redaction-safe facts plus transmission hash refs.
OETA-050 mapped Transmission status and control operations from runner job refs without rematerializing target links.

continue_policy.notes: Continue with route, smoke, README, and full package regression before closeout.
